questions_and_answers.question_text: Translate into English: Zhèi shi yíge pǔbiànde wèntí.
Translate into English: Xiànzài Shànghǎide jiàoshī shùliàng gòu bu gòu?

answers.answer_text: At present is the number of teachers in Shànghǎi sufficient?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Translate into Chinese: I'm an elementary school teacher.
Write a Chinese sentence using pǔbiàn as an adverb before a verb.
Translate into Chinese: How many English teachers are there in your school altogether?
Translate into Chinese: In America it is very common for one family to have three cars.
Explain the phrase cóng shùliàngshang kàn.

articles.text:
3. A: Xiànzài Shànghǎide jiàoshī shùliàng gòu bu gòu?
   At present is the number of teachers in Shànghǎi sufficient?
   B: Bú gòu, érqiě, zhèi shi yíge pǔbiànde wèntí.
   No, moreover this is a widespread problem.

Notes on No. 3

jiàoshī: "teacher," "schoolteacher"

Wǒ shi yíge xiǎoxué jiàoshī.
I'm an elementary school teacher.

Nǐmen xuéxiào yígòng yǒu duōshǎo Yīngwén jiàoshī?
How many English teachers are there in your school altogether?

shùliàng: "quantity," "number," "amount"

Nǐ néng bu néng shuōchū tāmende shùliàng yǒu duōshǎo?
Can you give an exact idea of their numbers?

Cóng shùliàngshang kàn, zhèige xuéxiàode nánshēng zhàn zhǔyàode dìwèi.
From the point of view of numbers, the male students occupy the main position in the school.

pǔbiàn: "to be universal/widespread/common"

Zài Měiguó, yíge jiātíng yǒu sānliàng qìchē shi hěn pǔbiànde shì.
In America it is very common for one family to have three cars.

Zài Zhōngguó, zuìjìn sānshínián, rénmende wénhuà jiàoyù shuǐpíng pǔbiàn tígāole.
During the last thirty years, people's educational level in China has seen widespread improvement.
